checks.name: profile page mounts the account billing and payment history panel
payment history uses the authenticated /payments/me query
payment history cache is scoped to the current account
subscription status cache is scoped and protected from anonymous requests
public subscription entitlements remain available to anonymous users
profile shows current subscription dates, days remaining and backend entitlements
Paystack initialization recovery calls the user-owned initialization endpoint
Paystack continuation only uses a confirmed, trusted HTTPS Paystack URL
payment verification handles approved, processing, pending and failed results
admin payment history is fetched from the dedicated paginated endpoint
admin subscription history is fetched from the dedicated paginated endpoint
admin user detail renders paginated payment and subscription histories
admin payment history tolerates optional pagination metadata
Paystack reconciliation uses the existing reference and does not create a new payment
manual approve/reject actions are separated from Paystack reconciliation
reconciliation errors can be cleared and retried
history routes are represented in the endpoint inventory
admin history services and hooks contain no duplicate import declarations
